description: Unauthorized Access to Sensitive Data in S3 Buckets Attackers could potentially access sensitive data if IAM policies are overly permissive or if bucket policies are misconfigured. The current implementation uses AWS managed encryption which could be upgraded to customer-managed keys for better control. An attacker with compromised credentials could access the S3 buckets and exfiltrate sensitive image/video data. Internal users might have broader access than necessary due to overly permissive IAM policies.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
recommendation: Implement customer-managed KMS keys for S3 bucket encryption
recommendation: Implement S3 bucket access logging and monitoring
recommendation: Implement strict bucket policies and IAM roles

description: Insufficient Authentication and Authorization Controls The system relies primarily on AWS IAM for service-to-service authentication but lacks fine-grained access control for different user types and proper authentication for external users. Different types of users (data scientists, developers, analysts) might have excessive permissions. External users could access system components without proper authentication.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1550 - Use Alternate Authentication Material
recommendation: Implement Amazon Cognito for user authentication

description: Insecure Data Processing and PII Exposure The system processes raw image/video data without proper PII detection, anonymization, or handling procedures. This could lead to unauthorized exposure of sensitive personal information. Processed images containing PII could be stored in the data lake or results storage without proper controls, leading to privacy violations.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1213 - Data from Information Repositories
recommendation: Implement PII detection and anonymization

description: Denial of Service Vulnerability Attackers could overwhelm system resources by sending large volumes of requests or data, causing service degradation or failure. An attacker could flood the Kinesis stream or S3 upload endpoints with data, overwhelming downstream processing components.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1498 - Network Denial of Service
mitreATT&CK: T1499 - Endpoint Denial of Service
recommendation: Implement AWS Shield and WAF
recommendation: Implement service quotas and throttling
recommendation: Implement circuit breakers and fallbacks

recommendation: Implement API Gateway with proper controls
recommendation: Implement VPC endpoints and private links

recommendation: Implement ML model security controls
recommendation: Implement clear model selection logic
